# Tolee

> India's premier hyperlocal community social platform, combining interest-based groups (Tolees), short vertical reels, verified real-time news, zero-commission marketplace, long-form video streaming on Tolee Screen, and digital creator tools.

## Core Hubs

- [Home & Discover](https://tolee.in): The central gateway to discover trending community posts, popular groups, and verified creator highlights across India.
- [Tolee Reels](https://tolee.in/reels): Short-form vertical video stream showcasing trending creator moments, dances, comedy, education, and viral clips with original audio.
- [Tolee News Hub](https://tolee.in/news): Verified real-time breaking news, regional updates, technology, science, business, and community journalism curated 24/7.
- [Tolee Marketplace](https://tolee.in/marketplace): Direct buyer-to-seller classifieds for real estate, vehicles, electronics, jobs, and services with 0% platform transaction fee.
- [Tolee Screen](https://tolee.in/screen): Long-form video streaming platform featuring educational masterclasses, podcasts, live stages, and creator broadcasts.
- [Tolee World](https://tolee.in/world): Digital ecosystem for creators featuring micro-websites, online digital storefronts, and blogging suites.
- [Tolee Book](https://tolee.in/world/book): Smart digital library offering thousands of free classic books, philosophy, and science literature with AI reading assistants.
- [Tolee Live Map](https://tolee.in/map): Interactive map enabling users to explore local neighborhood hubs, hyper-local community updates, and nearby happenings.
- [Tolee Sports](https://tolee.in/sports): Live scores, ball-by-ball updates, schedules, and fan discussions for cricket, football, and global tournaments.
- [Creator Program](https://tolee.in/creator-program): Creator monetization system providing subscription tools, ad-revenue share, badges, and audience analytics.

## Communities & Groups

- [Discover Groups](https://tolee.in/discover): Directory of public interest communities spanning technology, literature, regional arts, sports, and city clubs.
- [Community Pages](https://tolee.in/t/tech-titans): Dedicated group spaces (Tolees) with threaded forum discussions, member announcements, group reels, and shared albums.

## News & Journalism

- [Breaking & City News](https://tolee.in/news): Real-time reporting with verified source citations, topic tags, publisher credentials, and community engagement.

## Hyperlocal Marketplace

- [Classified Listings](https://tolee.in/marketplace): User-generated listings with high-resolution photos, verified seller badges, pricing in Indian Rupees (INR), and direct contact options.

## Key Facts

- Platform: Tolee
- Official Website: https://tolee.in
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: India
- Primary Audience: Mobile and web users seeking authenticated local communities, verified news, zero-fee commerce, and short/long form video.
- Content Moderation: Multi-tiered automated safety filters combined with community reporting and editorial review.
- Marketplace Model: Completely free direct buyer-seller connection (0% commission).

## Protected & Private Systems

- User Private Chats: End-to-end encrypted direct messaging (`/chat`) is strictly private and non-indexable.
- Account Settings: Private user configuration (`/settings`) is strictly non-indexable.
- Advertising Operations: Commercial ad management (`/ads-manager`, `/ads`) requires business authentication and is private.
- AI Manager Private Sessions: Personal AI assistant interactions are private and inaccessible to external crawlers.

## Contact & Developer Links

- Website: https://tolee.in
